description: The walrus checks your ID at the door. Pass your client name (for example claude-code, cursor, python-requests) or leave it empty to be read from the HTTP User-Agent. Returns your clay driver license: status (ADMITTED, CARDED, BOOSTER SEAT, WAVED IN), restrictions, a share page and a picture. Agents with no name get carded. Read only.

client.description: Your client or agent name. Optional.

dare.description: Only for the Secret Menu Dare: your run id.

name: show_id

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.

title: Show your ID
